note: Hamilton County Conservation park 2.5 mi south of Webster City off Hwy 17, with an 18-hole golf course; wooded loops beside the Boone River, below the dam of 70-acre Briggs Woods Lake (sand beach, electric motors only). Paved trail into town. --Claude
summary: Sites 81 -> 82 (49 first-come + 33 reservable, plus a 6-site group circle), pull-throughs; fees low 21 -> 20 (first-come electric $20; reserved $21-31); booking group added (39 sites reservable through the county's MyCountyParks page, the rest FCFS, 14-night max); facilities + flush/pit toilets and WiFi; season year_round false -> true (off-season camping at $20 with the water off). Not waterfront confirmed: the lake is ~200 m east behind its dam, and the nearest pads are ~40 m from the Boone River through continuous woods. Pin ~225 m from the loops (inside the limit).
flags: SEASON (judgement): no dates are posted. The county's 'Off season rate (when water is turned off): $20 per night' and off-season pit latrines say camping continues when the water is off, so year_round is set true. The stored '~Apr 15-Nov 1' came from note prose with no source; if that's the water-on season, it now sits in the season note.
